answer: An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 6 such diverse attestations are required. Buying 6 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the farming party's cost, and each one has to keep a grove record clean through the garden check. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce a zenith signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 10 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
